name: Bramble thicket
description: A dense, impassable mass of brambles and undergrowth about 1.5 × 1.5 m and 1.6 m high: dark bramble leaves over a near-black tangle, purple-red thorny canes arching out and drooping back, a few dead grey canes, clusters of ripe and unripe blackberries and a scatter of pale blossoms. Its ends match and its lumps repeat every 1.5 m, so thickets set side by side along x read as one continuous hedge.

provenance.prompt: A dense, impassable mass of brambles, briars and undergrowth about 1.5 × 1.5 m and 1.6 m high that reads as one continuous hedge when repeated.
